newsitem.title: MALTA: Malta tourism drops 5.3 percent in February.
newsitem.headline: Malta tourism drops 5.3 percent in February.

text.p: Tourist arrivals in Malta fell by 5.3 percent in February compared to the same month last year, the Central Office of Statistics said on Monday.
The office said 51,872 arrivals were recorded, compared to 54,801 in February 1996.
The biggest drop was in arrivals from Germany, the Mediterranean island's second largest market after Britain.
More British arrived in February than last year and there were also small increases registered in other markets, including France, Italy and the United States.
Prime Minister Alfred Sant, who is leading a drive to improve tourism facilities, said on Sunday he was optimistic that the 1995 arrivals figure of 1,115,971 would be surpassed this year.
